cards.text: You come round the corner into the end of something. Four people, one of them on the floor, and the specific quiet that happens after shouting rather than before it.
Two of them are wearing the kind of coats that cost money. They are not hurrying. One is writing something down.

By the time you've decided whether to do anything, there are two people and one of them is being helped into a car by the other. Nobody looks at you. It has been arranged that there is nothing to look at.
You ask Des about it later. He says "Firm," the way you'd say "rain," and asks whether you found anything.
